source: Official LFP 2026/27 calendar (published 10 June 2026); match dates/times from the ESPN Ligue 1 feed, validated against the official LFP round windows and the official broadcast programmes for rounds 1–3
kickoffNote: Kick-off times are CET/CEST (France). The LFP confirms kick-off times roughly three weeks before each round: rounds 1–3 are confirmed; later rounds show 'TBC' until the LFP publishes the times. Typical slots: Friday 20:45/21:05, Saturday 17:15/20:45, Sunday 15:00/17:15/20:45.
subjectToChange: Fixtures and kick-off times are subject to change (TV selections, European competitions, Coupe de France). BRYME updates the list as official changes are announced.
footnotes: Round 3: Toulouse FC–LOSC is officially scheduled for Thursday 3 September 2026, 20:45 (advanced match for Lyon's European commitments).
Round dates validated against the official LFP calendar (all 34 round windows; 305 of 306 matches fall inside their round window, the exception being the officially advanced Toulouse–Lille match).
